message.content: {"evidence":"P1 shows a persistent offset between J1 and J2 in all axes that is removed by the temporary-offset hypothesis, while the permanent-step hypothesis overcorrects after J2 and the isolated-point hypothesis leaves the offset intact; P2 and P3 fail because the interval between J1–J3 and J2–J3 contains additional steps (J2 and J3 respectively) and no sustained flat segment supports a single temporary displacement.","pair_ids":["P1"]}
